name: Fajr-5 333 mm MLRS
armament: 4 x 333 mm unguided or guided rockets (game: off-map strike or a map set piece)
protection: Unarmoured truck cab. Unarmoured. Game rule still treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; occupants, glass and tyres are exposed to all fire.
visual_notes: Mercedes-Benz 2624-style 6x6 truck chassis with a flat-fronted cab
Four very large rocket tubes in a 2x2 box on a rear turntable
